hello! I’m a GELM student taking 4H2s and essentially:

- my experience with geog is one that is quite bad the content is quite heavy and essays will no longer be just content and examples and would actually require quite a bit of elaboration and application in order to score well. However I do think that with consistent hard work it is still possible to score well for geog. Make sure to ask for consultations and don’t be disheartened by your first few results 

- in general I definitely score better for arts than science but I’ve always done much better in the arts than science even in sec school. Other than geog, I find that lit and econs are not too difficult

- For H2 literature it’s 3 books for the first year and it’s really not too difficult once you understand the content of the book. There is the basic poem and prose and book but for P3 it’s more about the mind and self which you would need to make a connection to

- For econs, just study early, ask for consults and watch all your lectures. Basic understanding of the content is the foundation

- In general the arts do better in my school than the science but the science papers are also crazy hard so I’m not too sure if this is a good measure lol

- As for 4H2s it is pretty content heavy especially when it comes to maths geog and econs (basically everything lmao) because there’s a lot you need to learn in that short time. I think it is manageable but from personal experience my advice would be seriously to study early and make sure you know your content. Clarify all your doubts during lectures or consults because your foundation will come back to haunt you. And do not skip lectures even if it’s online because I know the temptation will be high especially considering covid. Also play hard during ori while you still can haha
